'''Louis Cowart''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 Jacksonville tournament]] on 13 May 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down Duel]] and Throne Room Mains, according to Walter Cowart's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d739">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-jacksonville-fl-5-13-00d739/ jacksonville-fl-5-13-00], DeckTech (Walter "Walter" Cowart, 13 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-jacksonville-fl-5-13-00d739/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
